rows.quote: Outcome data for RP were obtained from the MRC IEU OpenGWAS database (Elsworth et al. 2020), and the following three independent GWAS datasets were utilized: ebi-a-GCST90018912 (121 cases and 126,333 controls), ebi-a-GCST90013904, and ebi-a-GCST90013954 (each with 403,833 total samples).
rows.coder_note: Step 3 of the decision order (rules B and C4, third case): the sentence gives the accession ebi-a-GCST90013904, which no outcome dictionary row lists by prefix, range or identifier (it is outside GCST90018563-GCST90019002, and is not GCST90027164 or GCST90132314/GCST90132315; no row lists an ebi-a prefix). The citation Elsworth et al. 2020 (CR25) is to the repository and has no DOI, PMID or PMC identifier, so it carries no code.
